dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: How are you? Do you need any help?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About fun activities...

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: Since the result is all the same, choosing one or more people from a group, then isn't it more fun to make a game out of it?

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: Some people think games are childish and I respect their opinion. After all, everyone playing games should participate voluntarily!

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: Unwilling participants will end up spoiling the game and ruining everything. That would leave everyone disappointed, and that's the opposite of why we have the games in the first place...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Coupons...

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: A very handy little thing, with a multitude of uses here in the Fortress of Meropide... Sorry, I don't mean to suggest anything...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: Be careful not to let Noailles bother you too much. Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: Do you need some help? I don't think you do, but I think it's rude not to ask.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Caterpillar...

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: Did you know he has two faces?

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: Haha. What I mean is, his personality completely changes depending on whether he's talking to Lanoire or to someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: You've probably noticed how kind he is to Lanoire. He even tells her the kinds of stories that little girls love.

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: Personally, I like those stories of his that aren't that suitable for kids. Stories with magic in them, where you never know how real or fake they are.

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: Now that I think about it, maybe Caterpillar doesn't see much difference between Lanoire and I. We're both kids, just with different interests.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Noailles...

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: He's sick. In the head. You get people like that, sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: If it was just about sticking to his principles, it wouldn't be an issue. But he tries to use the powers he's been given to force everyone else to adhere to his principles.

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: *sigh* Perhaps I should say the timing was just awful? Anyway, he's paying the price for what he did now and he won't be back anytime soon. Maybe he'll never get the chance to return.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About fun activities...

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: Since the result is all the same, choosing one or more people from a group, then isn't it more fun to make a game out of it?

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: Some people think games are childish and I respect their opinion. After all, everyone playing games should participate voluntarily!

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: Unwilling participants will end up spoiling the game and ruining everything. That would leave everyone disappointed, and that's the opposite of why we have the games in the first place...

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: But I don't think Rave and Caterpillar were breaking the rules. They were playing strategically, but that's within the rules.

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: The only thing I regret is that there were too few players. I just don't have the organizational skills... I'd love to host an even more exciting matchup!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: Sure, see you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Lanoire...

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: Actually, it's possible for me to just take her straight out of the Fortress, and bring her right to her family... But that would make me the primary culprit in breaking the rules, and I'm not willing to pay the price.

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: You might say, "Oh, that's so selfish of you!" and I'd say: you're right. There are countless people in the world who need rescuing, but I refuse to drop everything to save even one of them.

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: I'm just a small fry, and I can only do the things that smally fry can do, like lending a hand from the sidelines.

dialogues.speaker: Estienne
dialogues.text: Because I'm a small fry, I can forgive myself even if I don't condone my own decisions.
